title: Slovakian-Style Pork Roast
description: A hearty pork roast recipe inspired by traditional Slovakian flavors, featuring a nicely browned crust and a tender interior.
instructions: Season the pork roast with salt, black pepper, and caraway seeds.
Heat a large oven-safe pan over medium-high heat. Sear the pork roast until nicely browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes.
Reduce oven temperature to 325°F (165°C) and continue roasting for an additional 25-30 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C).
Let the pork roast rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
